notes: CANONICAL FILE written by the fomc-2027-07-28 initial-research lane (2026-09-06) after reading the one prior proposal, proposals/fomc-2027-07-28.from-consumer-confidence-2027-07-27.json, which is now inert. That proposal's claims were re-derived from the primaries rather than inherited and all held. WHAT THIS RESEARCH ADDS, none of it in the proposal. (1) CALENDAR TWIN: 2021 and 2027 are calendar-identical years (both non-leap, both starting on a Friday), and the Fed's 2027 meetings land on the IDENTICAL dates as their 2021 twins for Jan 26-27, Mar 16-17 and Apr 27-28, then diverge by exactly seven days for June (2021 Jun 15-16 -> 2027 Jun 8-9), September, October/November and December -- EXCEPT July, which returns to 2021's exact date, Jul 27-28. So 2027-07-28 is the ONLY 2027 meeting sitting between two seven-day-displaced neighbours, and the last date of the year to match its twin. (2) THE CONSEQUENCE, exact: it is flanked by 49 days on BOTH sides (Jun 09 -> Jul 28 -> Sep 15), the only 49/49-balanced meeting of 2027 and one of just six in the 167 scheduled meetings parsed here from the Board's own 2007-2027 calendars; every other equal-flank meeting in the record is 42/42. It therefore sits at the exact midpoint of a 98-day span containing no other FOMC decision -- the longest decision-free corridor of 2027. This is the downstream half of the eight-day June pull-forward the fomc-2027-06-09 ledger measured; that sibling stopped at June. (3) THE MEASURED DELIVERABLE -- JULY'S HOLLOW MIDDLE. On 156 FOMC decision days 2007-2026 (CBOE's own SPX_History.csv, 13,028 bars), July's mean absolute S&P move is an unremarkable 0.700% (n=13) -- but its MEDIAN is 0.125%, the lowest of any month, against 0.650% unconditionally. Mean/median ratio 5.60, the highest of any month (next: August 2.41, April 2.08) against 1.42 for all 156; permutation p = 0.00106. Bucketed: 7 of 13 Julys moved under 0.15%, 5 of 13 past 1.0%, and exactly ONE landed in between -- a 0.077 middle-band share against 0.436 unconditionally, p = 0.0047, and July's middle-band share is under half the unconditional share at all 25 threshold pairs tested. Mann-Whitney against the other 143 decision days gives z = -1.53: July's LEVEL is not different, only its SHAPE. The obvious mechanism is REFUTED, not assumed: conditioning on the actual policy action (FRED DFEDTARU, fetched this session) the 2023-07-26 meeting HIKED 25bp and the S&P moved 0.016%, while 2024-07-31, 2026-07-29 and 2020-07-29 all HELD and moved past 1.2%; restricted to held meetings only, July's middle-band share is 0.100 (1 of 10) against 0.495 for the other 101 held decision days. (4) VENUE: the KXFEDDECISION-27JUL ladder is the DEEPEST 2027 ladder (open interest 10,089 vs 27JUN's 1,962), quotes no-change at 0.77/0.78 -- the highest H0 of any 2027 meeting -- and is well-formed (single-peaked at H0), where 27JUN is the only malformed book of the twelve listed. The fomc-2027-06-09 ledger's depth correlation replicates on this session's independent fetch at corr(log ladder OI, log H26/H25 mid ratio) = -0.875, n=12 (that ledger: -0.879). SAME CHANNEL CAVEAT AS EVERY OTHER RATE ENTRY: symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is rates- or FX-keyed.
